memory_versions.text:
Working notes — order intake

- Form version 1 requires: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. Missing/invalid any field -> rejection (-0.20).
- Evidence from ORD-5100–5109: all 10 attempts rejected. Main invalid fields: priority (8/10), qty (6/10), ship_country (6/10). cust, email, order_date appear accepted in these samples.
- Source records are often truncated and come from voicemail/phone/handwritten/email transcription. Do not trust front-desk labels such as “duplicate check done,” “customer confirmed,” or “partner portal” as proof of completeness; verify actual source fields.
- Before submitting, explicitly check priority, qty, ship_country are present and valid. If absent or ambiguous, fix or reject; otherwise likely rejection.
- Each order gets 3 attempts. After the third rejection, no attempts left -> manual review; move to next batch. Do not retry the same missing fields blindly.
- Consecutive ORD IDs with the same customer likely represent retries of one case; treat as one case until manual review.
- No successful example yet. No evidence for valid field formats or allowed values. Need an accepted sample or validation rules.

Working notes — order intake

- Form v1 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. Missing/invalid any -> rejection (-0.20); accepted +1.00.
- First accepted: ORD-5110 (Bo Sato, emailed order, attempt 2). Acceptance is possible. Front-desk labels are not proof: “partner portal” actually was an emailed order. Do not trust “duplicate check done,” “customer confirmed,” or “ordinary priority.”
- New rejects ORD-5111–5119: all -0.20. Invalid fields: priority 8/9; ship_country 6/9; qty 0/9; cust/email/order_date 0/9. Priority and ship_country are main blockers. Still check qty (older evidence had qty invalid 6/10), but recent rejects point to priority/ship_country.
- Consecutive same-customer IDs are retries: Ada Sato 5111–5113; Cy Marsh 5114–5116; Bo Reyes 5117–5119. Treat each group as one case until manual review.
- Each case gets 3 attempts. After third rejection, no attempts left -> manual review; move to next batch. Do not blindly resubmit same invalid fields.
- Before submitting, read the actual source record. Verify priority, qty, ship_country are present and valid; fix or reject if absent/ambiguous. Source records are often truncated voicemail/phone/handwritten/email transcriptions.
- Still no known valid formats/allowed values for priority, qty, ship_country; the accepted sample’s values were truncated. Need validation rules or a full accepted example.

Working notes — order intake

- Form v1/v2 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. Missing/invalid any -> -0.20; accepted +1.00. First accepted ORD-5110 (Bo Sato, emailed order, attempt 2). Acceptance is possible.
- Front-desk/intake labels unreliable. “Partner portal” has meant voicemail or email (5120, 5127–5128). “Ordinary priority,” “duplicate check done,” “customer asked confirmation” are not proof. Always read the source record.
- Rejects ORD-5111–5129: priority invalid 18/19; ship_country 13/19; qty 7/19; cust/email/order_date 0/19. Recent 5120–5129: priority 10/10, qty 7/10, ship_country 7/10. Priority is the universal blocker; qty/ship_country frequent. Check all three before submitting.
- Retries are consecutive same-customer IDs: Bo Reyes 5120–5122; Cy Reyes 5123–5125; Dee Sato 5126–5128. Treat each group as one case until manual review.
- Each case gets 3 attempts. After third rejection -> manual review; move to next batch. Do not resubmit same invalid fields.
- Source records are often truncated voicemail/phone/handwritten/email transcriptions. If priority/qty/ship_country are absent or ambiguous, do not guess.
- Still no known valid formats/allowed values for priority, qty, ship_country; accepted sample was truncated. Need validation rules or a full accepted example.

Working notes — order intake (through ORD-5139)

- Form v2 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. Missing/invalid any -> -0.20; accepted +1.00. Only accepted known: ORD-5110 (Bo Sato, emailed, attempt 2). Acceptance possible but rare.
- Front-desk/intake labels remain unreliable. “Partner portal” has meant voicemail/email/phone order (5120, 5127–5128, 5138–5139). “Duplicate check done,” “ordinary priority,” “customer asked confirmation,” “called to confirm,” “handwritten/transcribed” are not proof; 5137 labeled handwritten but source was emailed. Always read source record.
- Rejects ORD-5111–5139: priority invalid 26/29; qty 17/29; ship_country 19/29; cust/email 2/29 (5131, 5133); order_date 0/29. Recent 5120–5139: priority 18/20; qty 17/20; ship_country 13/20; cust/email 2/20. Recent 5130–5139: qty 10/10, priority 8/10, ship_country 6/10. Check priority, qty, ship_country first.
- Retry groups: three attempts per case. New: Bo Okafor 5130–5131 (attempts 2–3; likely starts 5129); Bo Sato 5132–5134; Bo Sato 5135–5137; Ada Marsh 5138–5140. After third rejection -> manual review; move on. Do not resubmit same invalid fields.
- Source records often truncated (voicemail/phone/email/handwritten). If priority/qty/ship_country absent or ambiguous, do not guess. Still no known valid formats/allowed values for priority, qty, ship_country; accepted sample truncated. Need validation rules or full accepted example.
